_help: AI tip cards and videos for the AI tips page (only on the AI tips page; home has just one link to it). Tip: id (unique, kebab-case), icon (a name in tools/build-icons.mjs), color (blue|green|amber|pink|violet|teal|red), title (a few words), text (one short line (under ~10 words), plain language), optional try (an example to copy), optional link {href, label} (https://... or a site path like speech-transcriber/). Video: title, url (https://...), optional by, length (e.g. 6 min). Keep words few.

tips.title: Talk to it like a helpful friend
tips.text: Say what, who for, and how long.
tips.try: Write a short thank-you note to my neighbor for watering my plants. Warm, 3 sentences.

tips.title: Show it a photo
tips.text: Snap it, then ask about it.
tips.try: What does this letter want me to do? Explain simply.

tips.title: Double-check what matters
tips.text: AI can be wrong. Check health, money and legal answers.
tips.try: Where can I check this? Give me official sources.

tips.title: Let it ask you first
tips.text: Not sure how to ask? Let it interview you.
tips.try: I want to plan a birthday party. Ask me questions one at a time, then make a plan.

tips.title: Ask for simpler or shorter
tips.try: Explain that again like I'm new to this, in 3 short bullet points.

tips.title: Fix it in the same chat
tips.text: Say what to change. Don't start over.
tips.try: Good, but make it friendlier and cut the last part.

tips.title: Talk instead of typing
tips.text: Phone: tap the mic. Computer: Speech Transcriber.

tips.title: Never share secrets
tips.text: No passwords, card numbers or Social Security numbers.
